scope: Synthetic integer accounting checks only; no user refund or builder payment executed.
user_preference: Higher quoted ordinary tips and optional later user rebates are acceptable; no additional user payment or authorization.
checks: rebate principal and transfer cost never exceed settled surplus after costs, margin and reserve
unused rebate gas is not charged when no rebate is made
exactly funded service quote leaves zero customer rebate budget
lower realized costs permit a funded rebate without reducing retained profit or reserve
aggregate user tips paid to the builder are not assumed operator revenue
limitations: Later customer rebates require canonical settlement and external-payment reconciliation, durable identities and replay protection.
Higher quotes do not enlarge signed fee caps or establish universal deployed builder support.
